_notes: Vanilla 26.3 honeycomb waxing, bell ringing and redstone ore lighting by a use, recorded by Obsidian.AssetGenerator/Java/WaxingBellsOreFixtures.java (CaptureFixtures=waxing_bells_ore) on BlockUseFixtures' dedicated server in a flat world of air. Cases take block_use.json's inputs: blocks set around the target without updates, a player at 'player' (x, y, z, yaw, pitch) using the hand's item (two of it unless 'count' says otherwise) on the clicked face through ServerPlayerGameMode.useItemOn, then the tick's block events. Every case records block_use.json's outputs with checkWrites and checkEffects (result, changes, hand, particles, soundDetails, entities, the sounds, level events and block events a bystander above the target received, game events within 16, statistics, ordered writes with their flags and destroyed blocks), awardedCriteria where it lists criteria, and 'userEffects': the sounds, level events and block events sent to the acting player's own client, in order.
